007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.Conversation;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.ConversationAttributes;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
014import org.slf4j.Logger;
015import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
016
017/**
018 * Sample for creating a Select AI conversation.
019 *
020 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
021 * {@link ConversationAttributes} payload, obtain a {@link Conversation} object
022 * from {@link SelectAI#conversation(ConversationAttributes)}, call
023 * {@link Conversation#create()}, and print the generated conversation ID.</p>
024 *
025 * <p>This sample changes database state by creating a new conversation.</p>
026 *
027 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
028 * <ul>
029 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
030 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
031 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
032 * </ul>
033 *
034 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
035 * <ul>
036 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE - defaults to a sample title.</li>
037 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION - defaults to a sample description.</li>
038 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS - defaults to {@code 7}.</li>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH - defaults to {@code 20}.</li>
040 * </ul>
041 *
042 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
043 * <pre>{@code
044 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
045 * }</pre>
046 *
047 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
048 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
049 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
050 * <pre>{@code
051 * mvn clean install
052 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
053 * }</pre>
054 *
055 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
056 * <pre>{@code
057 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
058 *   -d samples/out \
059 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/conversation/CreateConversationSample.java
060 * }</pre>
061 *
062 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
063 * <pre>{@code
064 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
065 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.conversation.CreateConversationSample
066 * }</pre>
067 *
068 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
069 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
070 * and diagnostics.</p>
071 */
072public final class CreateConversationSample {
073    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreateConversationSample.class);
074
075    private CreateConversationSample() {
076    }
077
078    public static void main(String[] args) {
079        try {
080            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
081            ConversationAttributes attributes = buildConversationAttributes();
082            Conversation conversation = selectAI.conversation(attributes);
083            String conversationId = conversation.create();
084
085            System.out.printf("Created conversation ID: %s%n", valueOrEmpty(conversationId));
086            System.out.printf("Attributes: %s%n", attributes.toJson());
087        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
088            LOGGER.error("Failed to create Select AI conversation.", e);
089        }
090    }
091
092    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
093        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
094                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
095                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
096                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
097                .build();
098
099        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
100    }
101
102    private static ConversationAttributes buildConversationAttributes() {
103        return ConversationAttributes.builder()
104                .title(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_TITLE", "Java SDK Sample Conversation"))
105                .description(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_DESCRIPTION",
106                        "Conversation created by the Java Select AI SDK sample."))
107                .retentionDays(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_RETENTION_DAYS", "7")))
108                .conversationLength(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_CONVERSATION_LENGTH", "20")))
109                .build();
110    }
111
112    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
113        String value = System.getenv(name);
114        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
115            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
116        }
117        return value;
118    }
119
120    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
121        String value = System.getenv(name);
122        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
123    }
124
125    private static String valueOrEmpty(String value) {
126        return value == null ? "" : value;
127    }
128}
